alerts.title: U.S. pulls diplomats from Saudi Arabia as it reportedly readies Iran strikes after midterms
alerts.why: U.S. diplomatic withdrawal and threat of strikes on Iran amid regional attacks raise major Middle East supply disruption risks.

alerts.title: Iran war live: Trump says US not talking to Tehran; ships hit near Hormuz
alerts.why: Reports of ships hit near the Strait of Hormuz threaten vital crude supply flows, sparking immediate geopolitical risk premium.

alerts.title: Oil Prices Surge Above $111 as Houthis Strike Saudi Targets
alerts.why: Houthi strikes on Saudi targets and US diplomatic evacuation orders sharply raise Middle East supply disruption risks, pushing Brent above $111.

alerts.title: Iran’s Oil Reserves Run Dry as U.S. Naval Blockade Tightens
alerts.why: Draining of 100M barrels of Iranian floating storage due to a U.S. naval blockade significantly tightens global crude supply.

itemsSent.title: Japan’s Trade Deficit Doubles as Hormuz Crisis Hikes Energy Import Costs
itemsSent.why: Strait of Hormuz supply disruptions drive up global crude import costs for Japan, supporting Brent prices.

itemsSent.title: #SaudiArabia: crude and refined product inventories were at 199.561mb in August versus 226.193mb in July according to
itemsSent.why: Saudi crude and refined product inventories dropped significantly by over 26 million barrels in August, signaling strong demand and tighter market balances.

itemsSent.title: What the Ship: Hormuz Attacks Escalate as Container Lines Return to Suez
itemsSent.why: Hormuz escalation supports crude risk premia, but container lines returning to Suez suggests normalized transit expectations, limiting net near-term impact.

itemsSent.title: Higher Oil Availability Pressures Middle East Crude Benchmarks
itemsSent.why: Higher crude availability and slumping Oman-Dubai premiums indicate softening physical market strength in the Middle East, pressuring Brent-linked grades.

itemsSent.title: EIA Says US Crude Inventories Sink Further
itemsSent.why: US crude inventories fell by 3.1 million barrels, bringing stockpiles 3% below the five-year average, supporting near-term prices.

itemsSent.why: Expectation of aggressive Fed rate hikes increases macroeconomic pressure, strengthening the dollar and signaling potential demand destruction for crude.

itemsSent.title: Russia to send first diesel tanker to the US amid Trump deal
itemsSent.why: Russian diesel to the US increases refined product supply (bearish HO) but implies tradearounds, lowering crude demand locally (bearish CL).

itemsSent.title: (Public) Peak Hormuz
itemsSent.why: Reduced shuttle flow volume and maxed-out ship-to-ship transfers indicate potential physical logistics constraints and supply bottlenecks in the Middle East.

itemsSent.title: European gas rallies on Persian gulf disruption pressure; Hot UK Inflation dents
itemsSent.why: European gas rallies over 3% due to Persian Gulf disruption pressures and winter fuel adequacy anxieties.

itemsSent.title: Saudi Crude Exports Hit Five-Month High as Production Falls to Record Low
itemsSent.why: Higher exports draw down domestic storage, but record low production and lower refinery runs create conflicting supply and demand signals.

itemsSent.title: Russia’s Northern Sea Route Workaround Supplying Asian Buyers
itemsSent.why: Persian Gulf and Red Sea chokepoint disruptions boost risk premiums, forcing costly rerouting of Russian supplies via the Northern Sea Route.

itemsSent.title: FUJAIRAH DATA: Oil product stockpiles rebound as light distillates jump record 72%
itemsSent.why: Fujairah light distillate stocks surged a record 72%, signaling ample gasoline and naphtha supplies in the Middle East.

itemsSent.title: "Oil Was Pouring Through the Strait of Hormuz Again... BUT
itemsSent.why: Increased risk to transits through the Strait of Hormuz due to improving Iranian targeting raises geopolitical risk premiums for crude.

itemsSent.title: US orders departure of personnel from Saudi Arabia, citing Houthi threat
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical risk premium rises for Middle East crude supplies following US diplomatic personnel departure orders over Houthi threats.

itemsSent.title: Iran war live: IRGC vows invasion as defence doctrine turns ‘offensive’
itemsSent.why: Rising geopolitical tensions in the Middle East elevate Middle East risk premium and concerns over potential threats to regional oil supply routes.
